profile.headline: Software Engineer -   Building ML Tools for Fusion Research & Advanced Data Science | Building Immersive Experiences for VisionOS
profile.summary:
As a front-end engineer at Carnegie Learning, I write accessible, impactful code that empowers thousands of students in their math education. Drawing from my experience as a former teacher, I combine pedagogical insights with technical expertise to create engaging digital experiences that foster cognitive growth.

Beyond my work, I am the creator of Top & Bottom, an iOS and VisionOS app for outfit creation and wardrobe organization. Leveraging augmented reality, Top & Bottom allows users to measure clothing, capture and crop images of their wardrobe, and easily assemble outfits. I am also developing other VisionOS projects to explore new possibilities in mixed reality.

In every project, I prioritize collaboration and continuous learning. I support my team through code reviews, pair programming, and strategic planning. I communicate clearly by documenting processes, updating tickets, and leading focused meetings. I take ownership of my code, ensuring it is robust, tested, and aligned with current frameworks and tools. My mission is to create software that enables learning, growth, and joy.

https://github.com/gonzalj3.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AI Engineering · Web Development

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a front-end developer, I focus on building accessible, user-centric web applications with Angular.js. I design and implement features that ensure seamless interaction for all users, including those with disabilities. With a strong emphasis on accessibility, I work to meet WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) standards, developing components that provide clear, responsive feedback—such as text fields that indicate the correctness of entered information.
My role also involves testing to ensure functionality across different environments and user scenarios. Additionally, I support Angular migration projects, ensuring smooth transitions between versions, and work with APIs to enhance data integration and user experience. By combining technical expertise in Angular.js, testing, API integration, and accessibility, I strive to deliver robust, inclusive applications.

positions.title: Product Configurator Developer.
positions.description: My role included meeting with business managers to plan and prioritize updates to ensure the catalog application is updated with the latest pricing and product offerings. I follow change management processes to release catalogs that are accurate, free of defects, and are released within appropriate delivery dates.  I provide customer support to service representatives and retail store associates. I troubleshoot any catalog issues and develop appropriate resolutions where needed.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I assisted students with homework and class assignments in an after-school and summer program. I monitored student behavior while engaging students in learning activities. I developed student's critical thinking skills through board-games and fun activities.

positions.title: Facilities Coordinator
positions.description: I organized resources and employees to provide the Austin Achieve community a clean and safe environment. I followed all city/state ordinances for various facilities systems, including sanitary, fire, security systems. I recruited, hired and managed new employees by providing a healthy channel of communication. I organized and prepared venues for school functions.

positions.title: Implementation Associate
positions.description: I provided consultation and product management of InfoSnap Technology to end users. As well, I developed and Implemented online registration solutions by collecting existing customer information. I created and maintained project timeline by scheduling meetings and tasks. I supported customer related issues promptly by phone and email.

positions.title: Teach for America - 7th Grade Math Teacher - Raymondville ISD
positions.description: I planned with other teachers, administration, parents and students to determine and execute the best instructional practices and structural adjustments that will benefit the Raymondville community as a whole. This entailed creating and delivering lesson plans that engage and motivate students while keeping an eye to vertical alignment. We determined the appropriate adjustments to the school social structures and operations, such as schedule and behavior management plan, that will result in the most efficient and fruitful learning experience for students.

positions.title: Substitute Teacher
positions.description: I executed school assignments according to teachers instructions to continue the learning process. I provided classroom management to ensure student safety and a healthy classroom environment.

positions.title: Volunteer Recruiter and ESL Marketing Manager
positions.description: I tutored 15 students on an individual bases and catered lessons to students personal and work needs. I recruited and prepared tutors for tutoring program with preliminary academic help and assessment.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: I assisted customers in making the best purchase for themselves with their preference in mind. I initiated customers request for alterations and other changes in their purchases. I found and carried out solutions by using Nordstroms online tools to allocate customers requested items

positions.title: Founder and Head of Food Production
positions.description: Along with a good friend, Jon Ohara, I would bake, market and deliver cookies to residents around the UTSA campus. The experience included creating marketing material and determining where to place marketing material.  We also conducted customer surveys. I personally gained a great understanding of how to best satisfy customers when solving an important problem, how can I get a delicious dessert at 1:00 a.m. ?

positions.title: Reference Assistant
positions.description: I guided students and patrons to various research resources that the libraries provided. I publicized library functions through physical flyers and online social media marketing. I created web modules that demonstrated to patrons the most effective and efficient ways of utilizing databases, online journals and other reference tools.

volunteerExperiences.description: I assisted legal staff by translating legal documents from Spanish speaking countries. The legal staff gave me the opportunity in meeting with clients so that I would have an insight into the work of lawyers in the nonprofit field.
I collected and input data pertaining to both plaintiffs and defendants. Assisted in interviewing plaintiffs. Filed and organized confidential information.
